docs.purpose: Shows an admin the recent billing events that have hit one specific user's account, so support staff can check whether the payment provider is actually talking to that account without logging into the provider's own dashboard.
docs.data_story: It reads 3 tables — `user_profiles`, `entitlements` and `stripe_webhook_events` and writes nothing. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 3 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `admin_user_detail`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: Read-only, no audit row by design (stated in the header comment) — so writes_audit_row is false because there is no mutating method, not because one is missing. Event history is scoped to the profile's CURRENT stripe_customer_id, so events from a prior churned customer id are not shown; a separate last_stripe_event_at watermark (MAX across the user's entitlements rows) is returned as the honest last-touch signal covering that gap. Also cites docs/specs/02-web-admin/20_stripe_web_checkout.md. Called via a template-literal base in src/app/admin/users/[uid]/SubscriptionOps.tsx. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: EXTERNAL SERVICE CALLS: NONE. Despite being a Stripe-facing observability view, this route makes no Stripe API call and no Firebase/Supabase Admin call — it reads only the local dedup ledger (verified: the import block at :22-29 contains no stripe/supabase import). CENSUS CHECK: census_reads [user_profiles, entitlements, stripe_webhook_events] all confirmed; census_writes [] is correct for the route body, but the `profiles` read (verify-admin.ts:117-120) and the MFA-gated admin_backup_codes read/UPDATE are missed by the census for every admin route. No SELECT *. All SQL parameterised; no string interpolation into SQL anywhere in the file. Honest-boundary caveat is code-backed, not just comment: the events query filters on the profile's CURRENT stripe_customer_id (:82), so pre-mig-221 NULL-customer rows and prior-customer rows are invisible. | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control/revalidate/dynamic export in the file | Pagination: limit-only, clamped to [1,100] at :51-54 (MAX_LIMIT 100 at :31, DEFAULT_LIMIT 25 at :32), applied as LIMIT $2 at :84. No offset/cursor — the list is ORDER BY processed_at DESC and truncates silently past `limit`. | Other guards / classification: GET is not a MUTATING_METHOD so the CSRF Origin check is skipped by design (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:45,70). No admin_key restriction — read-only, so an admin_key caller IS allowed here (contrast the mutation routes). MFA gate INERT unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:143). | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-subscription-ops.infra.test.ts.
